newsitem.title: UK: SOCO makes fourth Mongolia oil find.
newsitem.headline: SOCO makes fourth Mongolia oil find.

text.p: British-based oil exploration company SOCO International Plc said on Tuesday it had made its fourth oil discovery in Mongolia.
SOCO said its SOTAMO 19-3 oil well in Mongolia was the country's first-recorded, free-flowing oil well and tested oil equivalent to 687 barrels per day.
The oil quality was approximately 37 degree API gravity -- similar to the SOTAMO 19-2 initial discovery well.

SOCO said it planned to complete its four discovery wells in summer and install production facilities. It said the oil would be trucked to China to be sold under an existing crude sales contract with China National United Oil Corporation.
